lines: Passive tree: right-click a node (touch: tap it, then Never take) to mark it never take. It gets a red cross, and Optimize, Plan and the node values skip it and never path through it. Kept per character.
Passive tree: right-click no longer takes a node.
Damage: Glass Cannon sets your Evasion to 0, so nodes that pay more damage per 1,000 Evasion give nothing while it is taken.
Passive tree optimizer: it no longer holds on to a notable only for its life-on-kill line, so it can move those points when they add no damage.
Damage tab: its "Also count" list is now the same one as the Skill tree, Item Simulator and Build Planner (ticks and weights carry over everywhere).
FAQ / Tundra Desert: clearer wording for the break (click Stitch to leave, or an Oath to keep going).
Skill tree, Item Compare and Gear Set Sim: "Also count" adds other skills with a weight, so the optimizer, Plan, node values and gear searches weigh them too. More skills make these slower.
Build Planner Skills: an "Include in simulations" box (with a weight) on each skill does the same.
Skill tree: Total DPS adds up the counted skills; the optimizer shows a progress bar on the button while it runs.
FAQ / Game Mechanics: new Tundra Desert section with how its reward grows at each break, its Oaths and its own reds (hover a red to see its lines).
The out-of-date pop-up lists what changed since your copy.
Item Search and Grail: reds from the Tundra Desert, the Catacombs, Gnome Realms, the Pinnacle and Oathborn now say where they drop instead of "Does not drop".
Damage: patch 70 rules. Extra Sparks hit for full damage again, Fortified adds 2% increased melee damage per stack.
Game data for Steam build 26617933 (Maim 10%, Multistrike 44% a strike, lower mana and life regen).
Item Search: Oathword cards show the top item-level lines; lower levels fold away.
